> Click any entry to open the notebook; PDFs are auto-built on Overleaf and synced to GitHub for full reproducibility.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="true"}
### Navigate & Run

Click any row to open the live notebook.

<script>
/* 让表格行可点击 = 直达 notebook */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('.listing-table tbody tr').forEach(row => {
    const a = row.querySelector('a');
    if (a) row.addEventListener('click', () => window.open(a.href, '_blank'));
  });
});
</script>
